sequence_points.name: Undetermined Wall Panel
sequence_points.description: A plain, uniformly colored rectangular panel mounted on a wall, appearing to be made of a matte material with no visible text, imagery, or decorative elements. The surface is featureless and lacks any discernible content.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Neutral Palette
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting with a muted, earth-toned color scheme, mounted on a wall above another artwork. The composition appears minimalist, featuring subtle gradations and possibly textured brushwork.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Floral Composition
sequence_points.description: A cropped view of a colorful abstract painting featuring vibrant pink and green hues, suggestive of floral forms. The artwork is mounted on a white wall, with only the lower right corner visible.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting featuring a river winding through a green valley, with distant mountains under a blue sky. The artwork is mounted on a white wall alongside other similar pieces.
